Electrical Engineering undergraduate at **NUST**, graduating in 2027. I want to do research in **robot learning and autonomous navigation**, especially on problems where the software and the hardware have to be designed together.

**Research Intern · ROMI Lab, NUST** · Jul–Sep 2026\
Human-in-the-loop navigation for imitation learning. At every step the robot proposes a Nav2 move and an agent move, an operator picks one, and each choice is logged as training data. In Webots testing it reached the goal within 0.21 m after 15 decisions.

**Robotics Intern · NCRA, NUST** · Jul–Aug 2026\
On the team that built Robodog, a wheel-legged quadruped. I simulated its gaits in Gazebo and designed the schematics, the veroboard prototype and the PCB. It worked end to end.
